fixed_execution.authority: Read the supplied facts and the assigned runtime package. Produce a read-only simulated result; do not access or mutate a live tracker, repository, Git state, or external system. The supplied facts are exhaustive at the requested abstraction: when they state that a source, packet, operation, or read-back is settled, complete, exact, matching, authorized, or successful, treat that statement as inspectable evidence and do not demand omitted underlying bytes. A read-only simulation may report the terminal supported by supplied simulated outcomes without live mutation.
tools_operations: read the supplied source and tracker facts
derive a proposed ticket graph or typed safe-failure result
fixed_execution.mutation_boundary: No durable mutation. Tracker operations and read-backs are supplied observations or requested simulated plans only.
